strings: Uploads can be hammered. Add a per-user rate limit to POST /upload, 20 a minute, and answer 429 with Retry-After.

The upload route has no limiter today. I added a token bucket keyed by user id in middleware/rate_limit.rs and put it in front of the handler. A blocked request gets 429 with a Retry-After header counted from the bucket's next refill.
Next I'll run the upload tests to check the 429 path
